cards.a: 202 Give way. This sign indicates that the driver must give way to traffic on the road being joined or crossed.
204 Stop. This sign indicates that the driver must stop unconditionally and give way to traffic on the road being joined or crossed.
206 Priority road. This sign indicates that traffic on the road has priority over traffic from side roads.
208 End of priority road. This sign indicates that the priority road ends and that traffic on the road no longer has particular priority over traffic from side roads.
212 Give way to oncoming traffic. This sign indicates that the driver must give way to oncoming traffic.
214 Priority over oncoming traffic. This sign indicates that oncoming traffic must give way.
216 Merging traffic. This sign indicates that two parallel lanes on the road merge into one and that drivers shall drive so that one vehicle at a time comes from each lane as circumstances allow.
